title: Build a testing calendar: one question per fortnight
hook: A content calendar fills slots. A testing calendar answers questions. Plan 2027 around the second.
caption:
A content calendar fills slots. A testing calendar answers questions. Plan 2027 around the second.

Start with what you do not know yet: founder or creator on camera, price-led or problem-led opening.

Rank the questions by how much money the answer would move. Give each one a fortnight, change one thing, and put the decision date in the diary.

Six questions fill a quarter, and each answer shapes the next brief.

The last slide shows one row of the calendar. Save it and build yours this week.

slides.headline: List what you *do not know* yet
slides.body:
Does a founder on camera beat a creator? Does a price-led opening beat a problem-led one?

Write down every open question. Then rank them by how much money the answer would move.

slides.headline: Give each question *one fortnight*
slides.body:
One question per cycle. One thing changes, while the product, offer and audience stay the same.

Six questions fill a quarter.

slides.headline: Put the *decision date* in the diary
slides.body:
Each test ends on a set day, in a set meeting.

The answer goes in writing, and it shapes the next brief.
